feishu.name: Feishu
feishu.description: Bring agents into Feishu chats, sync Issue topics, and collect messages for review.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Connect your workspace to Feishu and choose how messages reach Remi.

bot.title: Bot
bot.description: Manage workspace bots, their responding Agents, host Runtimes and app credentials.

access.title: Access control
access.description: Choose who can use the bot to create Issues.

conversations.title: Chats & notifications
conversations.description: Route private and group chats to agents and publish Issue updates to group topics.

ingestion.title: Message ingestion
ingestion.description: Authorize a message connection and choose the conversations to collect.

messages.title: Message history
messages.description: Search collected messages and review their outcomes and Issue proposals.

feishu.title: Feishu Messages
feishu.description: Pull messages from allowlisted Feishu chats and triage them here. Configuration lives in the control panel — no server access required.

endpoint.title: Message connection
endpoint.message_not_configured: No message connection is configured. An operator has to add one before messages can be pulled.
endpoint.message_unreachable: Unreachable ({{errorCode}}). Sources stay blocked until it recovers.
endpoint.message_stale: The last check didn't land. Showing the result from {{time}}.
endpoint.message_forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can see the ingestion service.

connection_dialog.title: Connect Feishu messages
connection_dialog.description: Enter credentials for a custom Feishu app. Multiremi creates an isolated configuration for this connection.
connection_dialog.authorization_description: Confirm authorization in Feishu. This page updates automatically when it completes.
connection_dialog.required: Enter a connection name, App ID, and App Secret.
connection_dialog.create_failed: Couldn't create the message connection. Check the app credentials.
connection_dialog.authorize_failed: Couldn't start Feishu authorization. Check that the app is published and has message permissions.
connection_dialog.poll_failed: The authorization status is temporarily unavailable. Waiting will continue.
connection_dialog.expired: The authorization link expired. Start authorization again.
connection_dialog.denied: Authorization was cancelled. Start authorization again.

sources.title: Message sources
sources.forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can manage message sources.
sources.empty: No message source yet. Create one to start pulling Feishu messages.
sources.empty_allowlist_notice: An empty allowlist ingests nothing. Add at least one chat before enabling the source.
sources.confirm_impact: This source covers {{chats}} chats, {{unprocessed}} unprocessed messages and {{proposals}} pending proposals.
sources.confirm_delete_description: Deleting removes the source, its allowlist and every message it ingested. This cannot be undone.
sources.confirm_disable_description: Pausing stops polling. Messages already ingested stay, but nothing new arrives until you enable it again.

dialog.description: A source pulls messages from allowlisted chats through a message connection.
dialog.endpoint_help: Connections are configured by an operator. Addresses and credentials are never entered here.
dialog.enabled_help: A paused source keeps its configuration but stops polling.
dialog.allowlist_help: Only messages from these chats are ingested. Everything else is dropped.
dialog.allowlist_error: Couldn't load the chat directory. The ingestion service may be unreachable.
dialog.allowlist_after_create: Chats can be added after the source exists — the directory is looked up through the source itself. Create it paused, add chats, then enable it.

messages.title: Feishu messages
messages.filters_description: Narrow the list by source, chat and time range.

dialog.ignore_description: Records why it was ignored and marks it processed. Nothing is sent to Feishu.
dialog.process_description: Records how it was handled and takes it off the unprocessed list. Nothing is sent to Feishu.
dialog.notify_description: Creates an Inbox item so a human picks this up.
dialog.draft_description: Saves the draft as an Inbox item. It is never sent to Feishu automatically — a human still has to send it.
dialog.propose_description: Creates a proposal. The Issue is only created after a human approves it.

concierge.title: Feishu concierge bot
concierge.description: Choose the responding Agent, host Runtime and Feishu app credentials for this bot. Each bot has its own configuration, lifecycle and conversation routes.
concierge.member_available: {{name}} is online. Message it in Feishu to reach this workspace.
concierge.member_unavailable: The concierge bot is configured but not reachable right now.
concierge.member_not_configured: No concierge bot is configured for this workspace yet.
concierge.member_hint: Only workspace owners and admins can change this configuration.
concierge.encryption_unavailable: The server has no credential encryption key, so credentials cannot be stored. Set MULTIREMI_FEISHU_BOT_ENCRYPTION_KEY and restart the control plane.
concierge.agent_hint: Used when no routing rule matches. Archiving it stops the bot.
concierge.agent_archived: This Agent is archived. The bot stays stopped until you pick another one.
concierge.runtime_hint: The daemon machine that connects to Feishu and executes bot Tasks. Only one machine hosts the bot at a time.
concierge.secret_will_clear: This value is removed when you save.
concierge.secret_unchanged: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
concierge.secret_write_only: Write-only. Once saved it is encrypted and never shown again.
concierge.registration_pending_save: Scanned app {{appId}} is ready. Save to store its credentials.
concierge.delete_confirm_description: The bot stops and its stored credentials are erased. You will have to enter the App Secret again to bring it back.
concierge.stale_runtimes: Waiting for other machines to release the bot: {{runtimes}}

error_codes.invalid_credentials: Feishu rejected the App ID or App Secret
error_codes.insufficient_permissions: The Feishu app is missing a required permission scope
error_codes.connector_start_failed: The host machine could not start the Feishu connector
error_codes.network_unreachable: The host machine could not reach Feishu

concierge.scan_dialog_description: Scan with Feishu to create the app and fill in its credentials. Entering an App ID and Secret by hand works just as well.
concierge.scan_hint: Open Feishu, scan the code, and approve creating the bot.
concierge.scan_ready: Credentials received. Close this dialog and save.
concierge.scan_error_denied: The request was declined in Feishu.
concierge.scan_error_expired: The code expired before it was scanned.

routes.title: Agent routing
routes.description: Choose the responding Agent by conversation type or specific group. Changes take effect immediately without redeploying.
routes.p2p_hint: All members' direct messages use the same Agent.
routes.group_hint: Groups without a specific route use this Agent.
routes.archived_fallback: This Agent is archived. This group has fallen back to ‘Group chats use’.
routes.archived_save_blocked: Replace or delete archived Agent routes before saving.
routes.issue_topic_present: Tip: Issue topic group ‘{{chat}}’ is already in the list.
routes.issue_topic_add: Add the configured Issue topic group in one click
routes.priority_hint: Priority: specific group › group/direct messages › Default Agent. Changing the Agent for an active group starts a new conversation.

dialog.title: Add group
dialog.description: Only groups the bot has joined are listed. Add the bot to a group first for it to appear here.
dialog.chat_error: Could not load the bot's groups.
dialog.effect_hint: Changes take effect as soon as routes are saved, with no redeploy. If this group already has a conversation, changing its Agent starts a new one.

senderAllowlist.agent_access: Anyone who can message this bot can use the responding Agent's enabled capabilities. The Agent's own permission and approval rules still apply.
senderAllowlist.require_allowlist: Require a sender allowlist to create Issues
senderAllowlist.title: Feishu account allowlist
senderAllowlist.description: Accounts that message this bot appear here automatically, with duplicates merged. Allowlisted accounts can ask the bot to create Issues in this private space.
senderAllowlist.configure_first: Configure the Feishu bot above to discover incoming accounts.
senderAllowlist.empty: No accounts discovered yet. Send a message to the bot to appear here.
senderAllowlist.load_failed: Could not load Feishu accounts. Refresh to try again.

issueTopics.title: Issue topics
issueTopics.description: Create one Feishu group topic for each new Issue and keep later work updates and replies in that thread.
issueTopics.enabled_hint: Only new Issues are synchronized. Issues created from an existing Feishu conversation keep that conversation instead.
issueTopics.chat_id_hint: Messages are posted as new topic roots in this group.
issueTopics.project_filter_hint: Leave off to include all projects and projectless Issues.
issueTopics.read_only: Only workspace owners and admins can change Issue topic synchronization.
issueTopics.toast_save_failed: Could not save Issue topic settings

lark.page_description: Connect each Multiremi Agent to a Lark (飞书) PersonalAgent Bot. Members can DM the Bot, @ it in groups, and type /issue to spin up a new Multiremi issue.

lark.legacy_description: These bots were installed with the older per-Agent flow. New connections are set up under Feishu concierge bot above.
lark.disconnect_confirm_description: The Bot will stop receiving Lark messages and the WebSocket connection will be torn down. The installation row is kept for audit; you can re-install later from the same Agent.
